about: Patterns that must not appear anywhere in data/, the store or the built site. A rule of level fail (the default) fails publish/build.py and publish/export.py on one hit. A rule of level warn fails the export and only warns in the build, because the data on main still has the shape; remove its level after the first publish whose build shows no warning for it. A rule with a scope reads only that column of the store and of data/tables/. Generic shapes only: a value that identifies a person or a machine never goes in this file, because this file is public. The export also applies the research repository's own leak rules, which stay private.
